correctness.rationale: Enumerated independently the 272 perfect matchings of Q4; down-closure gives 30,561 augmented faces with f-vector (1,32,400,2496,7776,10560,6848,2176,272). An independent successive edge-toggle matching makes 15,173 pairs leaving precisely 124 critical 3-cells and 91 critical 4-cells. All 150,720 Hasse cover incidences pass acyclicity topological sorting; independent mod-two Morse differential has rank 70, producing Betti numbers 54 and 21. Inspected the assigned verify.py integer projection and full unit-pivot row/column reduction: it asserts the entire remainder zero after exactly 70 unit pivots; since the Morse CW model has no dimensions 1,2 or >4, integral primitive 4-to-3 attachments can be canceled by unimodular handle slides, giving the actual wedge rather than just homology. Non-shellability follows from pure dimension7 but homology in dimensions3 and4.

value.rationale: The perfect-matching complex is a canonical but nontrivial graph complex; whether the known 2-connected two-degree free-homology result actually splits as a wedge is a substantive attaching-map problem, explicitly left unresolved by the earlier same-object theorem. The exact primitive Morse differential resolves that motivated topological gap and shows non-shellability of a pure seven-dimensional complex, an independently useful natural finite classification.
residual_risks: No extrapolation to arbitrary cubes or periodic-grid families, and no separate integral automorphism representation.

final_claim: The perfect-matching complex of Q4 (the 16-vertex, 32-edge binary four-cube) is integrally homotopy equivalent to a wedge of 54 three-spheres and 21 four-spheres, hence is pure 7-dimensional and non-shellable.
